chunks: And with this chain, from Sulaiman, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi, who said: I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and said to him: May I be your ransom,
His Exalted Saying: 'And indeed I am the All-Forgiving for him who repents and believes and does righteous deeds, then follows the right guidance,'
What is this guidance after repentance, faith, and righteous deeds?
He (a) said: (It is) the knowledge of the Imams, by God, one Imam after another.
ai.seo_question: What does the 'guidance' in Quran 20:82 refer to according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Fadail al-Shia, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the 'guidance' (hudan) following repentance, faith, and righteous deeds is specifically the recognition of the Imams, establishing their authority as the necessary culmination of spiritual perfection. This interpretation underscores the Shia doctrine that true adherence to divine law is inextricably linked to accepting the divinely appointed successors of the Prophet. It highlights the Imams not merely as political leaders but as the living embodiment of guidance required for the believer's complete salvation.
